item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. There's a refill call on the schedule for two weeks after your last fill — that's the whole job today. Don't wait for the bottle to run empty; make the call before it does. Everything else on your list, the walks, the meditation, the check-ins, works better when this one's handled and off your mind. Action: make that refill call today, not later.
